content.user_title: Check Japan Disaster Alerts from JMA
content.value_statement: Japan disaster information spans earthquake reports, regional warnings, and tsunami bulletins. This skill guides retrieval from public JMA feeds with publication times and explicit failure notices.
actual_capabilities: Guide retrieval of recent JMA earthquake events, including occurrence time, epicenter, magnitude, and maximum seismic intensity.
Retrieve earthquake detail files using filenames supplied by the current event list.
Locate regional weather warnings and advisories using JMA office codes.
Check the active tsunami information list and distinguish empty results from retrieval failures.
Report publication times and flag potentially stale warning responses.
Apply timeout guidance, limited retries, and official JMA fallback links after failures.
limitations: Requires internet access and an assistant environment able to retrieve HTTPS data; the supplied examples use curl.
Provides retrieval instructions, not continuous monitoring, push notifications, earthquake prediction, or routine weather forecasts.
JMA detail files expire, and warning responses can retain older publications.
The referenced shared response checklist is not included in the supplied single-file package.

use_cases.title: Review Regional Disaster Information
use_cases.description: Check local weather warnings and tsunami bulletins with publication times before consulting official emergency announcements.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Earthquake Brief
use_cases.description: Retrieve recent earthquake events and detailed regional intensity observations for a factual brief with source times.

use_cases.title: Check Operational Conditions
use_cases.description: Summarize JMA warnings for relevant office areas and clearly disclose retrieval failures or stale reports.

prompt_templates.title: Latest Earthquakes
prompt_templates.prompt: Show recent JMA earthquakes with occurrence time, epicenter, magnitude, and maximum seismic intensity. State any retrieval failure.

prompt_templates.title: Local Weather Warnings
prompt_templates.prompt: Check JMA weather warnings for [region]. Verify the office code, include publication times, and flag potentially stale reports.

prompt_templates.title: Earthquake Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Find details for [earthquake] using the current JMA list's detail filename. Summarize regional intensities and include publication time and source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: follow an event into its detailed bulletin.

prompt_templates.title: Combined Disaster Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a JMA disaster brief for [region] covering earthquakes, weather warnings, and tsunami information. Include publication times, disclose failures, and recommend official confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine multiple disaster information feeds.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: the JMA tsunami list was retrieved successfully and contained no entries.
output_examples.output: No tsunami information is currently published in the retrieved JMA list. In an emergency, confirm official JMA and local-government announcements.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: regional warning retrieval timed out and limited retries also failed.
output_examples.output: JMA warning retrieval failed after limited retries. Current warning status is unknown. Check https://www.jma.go.jp/bosai/map.html and local-government announcements.

best_practices: Include publication times and clearly identify stale reports before describing information as current.
Use timeouts, limit retries to one or two attempts, and avoid repeated requests in short intervals.
Confirm emergency decisions through official JMA and local-government announcements.
anti_patterns: Treating a timeout or HTTP error as evidence that no disaster information exists.
Reusing the historical earthquake detail URL instead of retrieving a filename from the current list.
Relying only on assistant summaries for evacuation or other emergency decisions.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The skill uses public JMA feeds without API keys or login.

faq.question: Which information does the skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers recent earthquake reports, earthquake details, regional weather warnings and advisories, and active tsunami information.

faq.question: Does it provide daily weather forecasts?
faq.answer: No. Routine weather forecasts are outside this skill's scope.

faq.question: Why can an earthquake detail link return 404?
faq.answer: JMA removes individual detail files after several days. Retrieve a current filename from the earthquake list instead of reusing the historical example.

faq.question: What does an empty tsunami list mean?
faq.answer: After successful retrieval, an empty list means no tsunami information is currently published in that feed. Retrieval failures do not establish that status.

faq.question: Can this replace official emergency guidance?
faq.answer: No. Always confirm emergency information with JMA and local-government announcements, and check publication times.
